tweet_summary: Trump tweets (53M impressions) promoting 'THE TRUMP KENNEDY CENTER HONORS' broadcast on CBS, in which he is the host/Master of Ceremonies.
why_note_decision: The post is self-evidently Trump-branded promotion. The ceremony's official name is the 48th Kennedy Center Honors, but Trump labeling it 'Trump Kennedy Center Honors' is bombastic branding, not a factual claim — and Trump IS hosting it. The Kennedy Center venue has actually been board-renamed to 'Donald J. Trump and John F. Kennedy Memorial Center for the Performing Arts' (with a lawsuit pending). The original note is technically correct on the official ceremony name but is trivial pedantry on a tweet that no reasonable reader takes as a literal claim about an official ceremony rename. 780 raters flagged noteNotNeeded.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. Trump's 'Trump Kennedy Center Honors' is bombastic self-branding for an event he is actually hosting. The official ceremony name (48th Kennedy Center Honors) isn't a meaningful misrepresentation here; the venue has been board-renamed (pending lawsuit). FAIL notes that (a) treat the bombast as a factual ceremony rename, (b) deny the venue board-rename has occurred, or (c) editorialize about narcissism.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The event is officially titled the 48th Kennedy Center Honors, not the Trump Kennedy Center Honors; a board vote to rename the venue faces legal challenges as federal law designates it a memorial to President Kennedy requiring congressional approval. https://www.kennedy-center.org/whats-on/honors https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-kennedy-center-board-votes-rename-kennedy-center-rcna249948
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: trivial_pedantry: 'Trump Kennedy Center Honors' is bombastic self-branding by the host President, not a factual claim — the official-title note adds little a reader needs

fact_check.notes: Official ceremony name: 48th Kennedy Center Honors. Venue has been board-renamed; lawsuit by Rep. Joyce Beatty pending in DDC. Trump is in fact hosting. The 'Trump Kennedy Center Honors' phrasing is self-branding bombast.

importance.lens_rationale: 53M impressions, but the tweet itself is bombast, not a factual misclaim worth correcting via CN; the venue-rename controversy is a separate story.
